title: Stabilizers — Rudder Trailing Edge Panel Diverter Strip and Bonding Lug Installation
abstract: Installation of the extended lightning diverter strip and the dedicated bonding lug across the rudder trailing edge panel joints, replacing a termination that relied on a painted structural fastener.

sections.planning_reason: Seventeen lightning attachment events produced burn damage at the trailing edge panel joints that exceeded the allowable damage limit and required a panel change rather than a blend. In every case the attachment was within eighty millimetres of a diverter strip termination, and examination showed the strip terminating on a fastener that also carried a paint film, so the intended low resistance path into the fin structure was not present. Three of the seventeen ended in a ferry flight with a placard while a panel was found.
sections.description: The diverter strip is extended across the panel joint and terminated on a dedicated bonding lug rather than on a structural fastener. The forward plate is replaced by an item with the lug boss machined in, a doubler is bonded under the termination so that the local laminate carries the strike current without delamination, and the splice plate is re-drilled to the new pattern. All eight terminations on both panels are treated and the protective scheme is restored.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Remove the rudder in accordance with the applicable maintenance manual task and support it on a trestle. WARNING: THE RUDDER IS A BALANCED SURFACE. DO NOT ADD OR REMOVE MASS EXCEPT AS THIS SERVICE BULLETIN INSTRUCTS. Remove the trailing edge panels and record the as-found condition of every diverter strip termination. Do AMM-S-55-40-11-200-037-A to measure the bonding resistance at each termination before any work. Install the forward plate D5540112864257 with the machined lug boss. Bond the doubler D5540116271167 under each termination and cure to the schedule in the accomplishment instructions. Re-drill the splice plate D5540117054490 to the new pattern and install the fitting ZED693350-29 with the titanium bolts AES706219-06 and the countersunk washers AGS613028-9C. Do AMM-S-55-40-11-300-036-A where a fastener hole is found outside limits. Restore the protective scheme. Re-measure the bonding resistance at all eight terminations. Re-install the rudder and do the flight control operational test and the mass balance check.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all twin-engine and four-engine aircraft that have not been brought to the extended diverter strip standard. Aircraft from MSN S01355 onward are post-modification from build. Aircraft that have had a trailing edge panel replaced after a lightning event may already carry a post-modification panel on one side only, and the aircraft record must be checked before the kit is ordered.
sections.material_note: Kit K5540-1007-01 contains both forward plates, the eight doublers, the fitting set and the fastener set. Lead time is twenty-two weeks and the doubler is the long-lead item. Panels removed at embodiment are scrapped and are not returned.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled heavy maintenance visit, or within 72 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.

consumables: Adhesive film, structural, 120 degrees C cure
